system.description: Boost one physical Attribute (Body, Quickness or Strength; each bought separately) by the power's level. Activate with a Magic Rating test against the Attribute's current value: any success raises it by the full level for as many Combat Turns as successes. When it ends, resist Drain (Willpower against half the boosted value, rounded down).
system.notes: Cost 0.5 per Level, one Attribute per purchase. Drain Level by the boosted rating: up to ½ racial maximum L, up to the maximum M, up to 1.5× S, beyond D; 2 successes lower it one level; Stun. Not with cyberware, bioware or spells raising that Attribute; works with Improved Physical Attributes. Grimoire p.34.
